notes: Positive cases are phrasings that should load web-design. Negative cases are the adjacent territory the generic name invites — feature/functionality building, layout debugging without design intent, framework choice, copywriting (belongs to web-copy), paid-font requests, and design-system violations like token renames. Because web-design is a broad name, the negative surface matters as much as the positive.
